sections.content: The repository routes work through typed, hash-bound, non-authorizing skill inputs. Quick Dev owns ordered RED, GREEN, and REFACTOR execution; VDD defines planning and lifecycle boundaries; acceptance builds evidence without granting release or publication authority.

sections.content: The toolchain repair plan covers typed selection, transport continuity, adapter coverage, knowledge gates, immutable generations, retention controls, and end-to-end validation. ADRs, validators, registries, tools, policies, and focused tests consistently require fail-closed integrity checks and empty authorizations.
